caption:
"I'll stop thinking about it tomorrow." You said that Tuesday. Your brain returns to what it can't resolve. The Last Word gives the loop an ending.

We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this for the thought that keeps coming back.
